title: Coherent differentiation with a monoid of degrees: derivatives, Taylor expansion, finite differences...
summary: Coherent differentiation has been introduced a few years ago as a refinement of the (categorical semantics of the) differential lambda-calculus and of differential linear logic, compatible with the determinism of computation, and hence in categories where addition of morphisms in the hom-sets is only partially defined. In this setting differentiation is implemented by a kind of ''tangent functor'', with the difference that it maps an object to its object of summable tuples rather to a tangent bundle.
